tasks.instruction_text: I'm scoping a Oracle Cloud workload for a customer in us-ashburn-1 (Ashburn — VA) — set up a quote for Compute (VM.Standard.E4.Flex — 1 OCPU), override the default usage to 1460 VM-hours (2 VMs always-on) for the month, and pin the Premier Support tier since this is a regulated tenant.

Could you put together a Compute (BM.Standard.E4.128 — 128 OCPU) quote? Always-on 1-month workload — use 730 OCPU-hours (1 month always-on) — and bill it out of us-phoenix-1 (Phoenix — AZ), the Premier Support tier is fine, we don't need anything fancier.
Need to estimate Block Volume (Balanced) sitting in us-sanjose-1 (San Jose — CA) at about 500 GB storage. We're on the Basic tier anyway.
Configure the calculator for Object Storage (Standard) in us-chicago-1 (Chicago — IL) — usage around 500 GB storage per month and we're already on the Premier Support tier for the FedRAMP tenant.
What's the projected monthly bill for Autonomous Database (1 OCPU) in ca-toronto-1 (Toronto — ON) doing 730 OCPU-hours (1 month always-on), with the Basic tier attached?

Quick check — if I put 1460 VM-hours (2 VMs always-on) through Oracle Database (Standard Edition — 1 OCPU) in sa-saopaulo-1 (São Paulo — BR), on the Basic tier, what does the monthly estimate come to?

Hmm, what would Compute (VM.Standard.E4.Flex — 1 OCPU) cost me in eu-frankfurt-1 (Frankfurt — DE) for a 1460 VM-hours (2 VMs always-on) monthly commitment if I add the Premier Support tier on top? Just want the number.

Pricing exercise for a finance review: configure the calculator for Object Storage (Standard) in eu-amsterdam-1 (Amsterdam — NL), override usage to 500 GB storage, leave support at the Basic tier, then tell me the all-in monthly total — they want it for the budget doc.

OK so I need to estimate Compute (BM.Standard.E4.128 — 128 OCPU) running in uk-london-1 (London — UK) for one month — use 730 OCPU-hours (1 month always-on) — and we're on the Premier Support tier; set it up in the calculator and give me the monthly figure.

Hey, can you set up an estimate for 1460 VM-hours (2 VMs always-on) out of eu-zurich-1 (Zürich — CH) on Oracle Database (Standard Edition — 1 OCPU) and tell me the monthly cost? We're on the Basic tier, but if it's over $1000/month we'll probably want to revisit.
